verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full flow. You can accept customer USDC and auto-convert it to USD into a treasury, or provision deposit addresses that auto-credit a custodial account with optional auto-liquidation. Fiat can then be paid out to bank accounts over ACH, Fedwire, Swift or SEPA. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; detail on conversion rates, fees and timing; explicit confirmation that checkout-API stablecoin payments settle directly in fiat.
